c: Slice palm heart paper-thin on a mandoline; hold in lime water so it does not brown.
Whisk lime, oil, salt, pepper and chilli.
Drain palm heart, dress to order with mango, spring onion and coriander.
3bc01e52.st: Sliced palm heart in lime water: 0–4 °C, 12 h. Dress to order.
3bc01e52.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Known as 'millionaire's salad'; tinned heart of palm is a fallback only.

c: Tenderise: freeze 48 h and thaw at 0–4 °C (or beat the tentacles in the traditional way).
Remove beak, eyes and ink sac; wash well.
Dip 3 times into boiling water, then simmer gently with bay and salt 45–60 min until a knife slides in; core ≥ 63 °C.
Cool in the cooking liquid; cut into 3 cm pieces.
Mix with finely sliced red onion, diced tomato, chilli and crushed garlic.
Dress with lime, oil and salt; marinate 1 h at 0–4 °C.
Finish with spring onion and parsley; serve cold.
Peel papaya, remove seeds; julienne 2 mm.
Salt 20 min, then squeeze dry in a cloth.
Mix with finely sliced onion, grated ginger and garlic, chilli, lime, sugar and oil.
Finish with spring onion and coriander; rest 30 min, 0–4 °C.

e4130fb0.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 80 g (cold starter or side)
c: Flake fish finely; remove all bones and skin.
Sweat finely chopped onion, garlic, ginger in oil 3 min; add turmeric 30 s; cool.
Mix fish, onion mix, bilimbi julienne, chilli, lime, spring onion and coriander; season.
e4130fb0.al: 4 Fish (smoked tuna or kingfish). Classic satini reken is made with shark; the resort version uses smoked tuna or kingfish.

c: Sweat onion, garlic, ginger and thyme in oil 4 min.
Add tomatoes 2 min, then water and diced chayote; simmer 10 min.
Add the greens for the last 2–3 min only, so they stay green.
Season; serve at once with rice or grilled fish.
aa3db9af.st: Broth base without greens: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Add greens to order.

80817373.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ½ lobster ≈ 300 g (in shell)
c: Soften butter; beat in grated garlic and ginger, chopped chilli, spring onion, parsley, lime and salt.
Chill live lobsters 20 min, then dispatch with a knife through the head; split lengthwise.
Remove the stomach sac and the intestinal tract.
Grill flesh side down on hot charcoal 3–4 min; turn, brush with butter, 4–5 min more (core 60–63 °C).
Serve with melted Creole butter and lime wedges.
80817373.st: Live lobster: 4–8 °C, damp cloth, 24 h. Butter: 0–4 °C, 5 days.

8f038ec3.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 410 g (260 g curry + 150 g rice)
c: Cut chicken into 4 cm pieces; season with salt, turmeric and 10 g curry powder.
Brown in oil; remove. Sweat onion, garlic, ginger, chilli, curry leaves, cinnamon, cloves, thyme.
Fry the rest of the curry powder 1 min; add tomatoes, cook 5 min.
Return chicken, add water and potatoes (3 cm), simmer covered 20 min.
Add coconut milk, simmer 10 min (core 75 °C); finish with coriander. Serve with rice.
Wash rice until the water runs clear; drain 10 min.
Bring water and salt to the boil, add rice, cover; lowest heat 15 min.
Off the heat 10 min covered; fluff with a fork; hold 65 °C max 2 h.
8f038ec3.st: Curry: 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat to 75 °C once only.
8f038ec3.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Check curry powder label (may contain 9 Celery or 10 Mustard).

ffb3331a.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 360 g (210 g curry + 150 g rice)
c: Cut fish into 5 cm pieces; marinate with lime, turmeric and half the salt 15 min, 0–4 °C.
Sweat onion in oil; add garlic, ginger, chilli, curry leaves, thyme; fry curry powder 1 min.
Add tomatoes and tamarind, cook 5 min; add coconut milk, simmer 10 min.
Lay fish in the sauce, poach gently 6–8 min (core 63 °C); shake the pan, do not stir.
Finish with coriander. Serve with rice.
Wash rice until the water runs clear; drain 10 min.
Bring water and salt to the boil, add rice, cover; lowest heat 15 min.
Off the heat 10 min covered; fluff with a fork; hold 65 °C max 2 h.
ffb3331a.st: Fish: 0–2 °C, 24 h. Sauce base without fish: 0–4 °C, 48 h; cook fish to order or in small batches.
ffb3331a.al: 4 Fish (grouper / job fish fillet). Check curry powder label (may contain 9 Celery or 10 Mustard).

8f5b6858.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 380 g (230 g curry + 150 g rice)
c: Tenderise: freeze 48 h and thaw at 0–4 °C (or beat the tentacles in the traditional way).
Remove beak, eyes and ink sac; wash well.
Dip 3 times into boiling water, then simmer gently with bay and salt 45–60 min until a knife slides in; core ≥ 63 °C.
Cool in the cooking liquid; cut into 3 cm pieces.
Sweat onion in oil 8 min until golden; add garlic, ginger, chilli, curry leaves, cinnamon, thyme 1 min.
Add curry powder and turmeric, fry 1 min (do not burn); add chopped tomatoes, cook to a paste 5 min.
Add octopus, stir to coat; add coconut milk, simmer gently 15–20 min until glossy and thick.
Finish with lime juice and coriander; season. Serve with rice.
Wash rice until the water runs clear; drain 10 min.
Bring water and salt to the boil, add rice, cover; lowest heat 15 min.
Off the heat 10 min covered; fluff with a fork; hold 65 °C max 2 h.
8f5b6858.st: Cooked octopus: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Curry: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat to 75 °C. Rice: cool within 90 min, 0–4 °C, 24 h.
8f5b6858.al: 12 Molluscs (octopus). Check curry powder label (may contain 9 Celery or 10 Mustard).

c: Soak salted fish 12–24 h at 0–4 °C, changing the water 3 times; poach 5 min, flake, remove bones.
Cut breadfruit into 4 cm wedges, remove the core.
Sweat onion and garlic in oil; add thyme, bay, chilli, then coconut milk and breadfruit.
Simmer gently 20–25 min until tender; add fish, 5 min more. Shake the pan, do not stir.
Taste before adding any salt; finish with spring onion and pepper.
5578189c.st: Soaked fish: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Ladob: hold 65 °C max 2 h; 0–4 °C, 24 h.
5578189c.al: 4 Fish (salted fish). The sweet ladob (plantain or breadfruit with sugar, vanilla and nutmeg) is a dessert, so it is not included here.

6e759667.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 fish ≈ 430 g (bone-in, with sauce)
c: Pound garlic, ginger, chilli, thyme and salt to a paste; mix in turmeric, pepper, lime and oil.
Dice tomatoes and onion 3 mm; chop spring onion, parsley, chilli.
Mix with lime, oil and salt 30 min before service; keep 0–4 °C.
Scale, gut and rinse fish (≈ 450 g each); score 3 cuts per side to the bone.
Rub marinade into the cuts and cavity; marinate 30 min, 0–4 °C.
Grill over hot charcoal in an oiled fish basket 6–7 min per side; core 63 °C at the backbone.
Serve with 48 g sauce Kreol and lime wedges.
6e759667.st: Whole fish: 0–2 °C on ice, 48 h. Marinade: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Sauce Kreol: 0–4 °C, same day.

33c2b875.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 380 g (230 g rougay + 150 g rice)
c: Season fish steaks (140 g) with salt and turmeric; pan-fry in half the oil 2 min per side; set aside.
Sweat sliced onion in the rest of the oil 6 min; add pounded garlic, ginger, chilli, thyme 1 min.
Add diced tomatoes, cook 15 min to a thick red sauce (the rougay).
Return fish, cover, simmer 5 min (core 63 °C); finish with spring onion and parsley.
Wash rice until the water runs clear; drain 10 min.
Bring water and salt to the boil, add rice, cover; lowest heat 15 min.
Off the heat 10 min covered; fluff with a fork; hold 65 °C max 2 h.
33c2b875.st: Rougay sauce: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Fried fish: finish to order or same day.
33c2b875.al: 4 Fish (kingfish). Same base works with salted fish or Creole sausages (rougay sosis).

c: Peel breadfruit, quarter, remove the core; cut into 1 cm wedges.
Blanch in salted water 5 min; drain and dry well.
Fry at 170 °C 4–6 min until golden and crisp; salt at once.
Option: roast whole on embers 1 h, then peel and slice.
b1f31e68.st: Blanched wedges: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Fry to order.
b1f31e68.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Fry in fish-free oil (not shared with seafood) for allergen control.

c: Wash lentils; simmer in water with turmeric 20 min until soft; skim.
Fry cumin seeds and curry leaves in oil 30 s; add onion 6 min, then garlic, ginger, thyme 1 min.
Add tomatoes, cook 5 min; stir into the lentils, simmer 5 min.
Season; whisk to a creamy pouring texture; finish with coriander.
00a46141.st: 0–4 °C, 72 h; loosen with water when reheating to 75 °C.

c: Slice breadfruit 1.5 mm on a mandoline into 5 cm rounds; rinse off the starch, dry well.
Fry at 160 °C 2–3 min until golden; salt at once; dry on paper; keep airtight.
Blend bilimbi with water and sugar; pass through a fine sieve.
Boil with agar 1 min; set at 0–4 °C 30 min; blend to a smooth fluid gel; pipe bottle.
Flake fish very fine; remove all bones.
Mix with shallot brunoise, grated ginger, chilli, lime, oil and chopped coriander; keep 0–4 °C.
To order: 7 g satini quenelle on each crisp, 3 dots of gel, micro herbs.
Serve 3 pieces on a stone or banana leaf; build max 5 min before service so crisps stay crisp.
af94e0a5.st: Crisps: airtight, 24 h. Gel: 0–4 °C, 3 days. Satini: 0–4 °C, 24 h.

c: Freeze 48 h, thaw at 0–4 °C; remove beak and eyes.
Simmer gently with bay and salt 45–60 min until tender, core ≥ 63 °C; cool in the liquid; dice 5 mm.
Cut green bananas 2 cm thick; fry at 150 °C 3 min until soft but pale.
Press flat to 4 mm between baking paper.
Fry again at 180 °C 1–2 min until crisp; salt at once.
Mix diced octopus with seeded tomato and red onion brunoise, chilli, lime, oil, coriander; rest 30 min at 0–4 °C.
To order: 22 g satini on each tostada; micro herbs; 2 pieces per guest.
8ca2e137.st: Octopus: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Satini: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Tostadas: airtight, same day.

8fab7756.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 3 croquettes + aioli ≈ 95 g (snack)
c: Freeze 48 h, thaw at 0–4 °C; remove beak and eyes.
Simmer gently with bay and salt 45–60 min until tender; cool in the liquid.
Sweat onion, garlic, ginger, curry leaves in butter 4 min; fry curry powder 1 min.
Add flour, cook 2 min; whisk in coconut milk; cook 5 min to a very thick sauce.
Fold in octopus; season; spread flat, cover, chill 2 h until firm.
Fry to order at 175 °C 2–3 min until golden (core 75 °C); drain.
Blend egg, garlic, lime juice and salt; stream in oil to a thick emulsion; finish with zest.
Serve 3 hot croquettes on a stone with 20 g aioli in a small dish.
8fab7756.st: Filling: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Crumbed croquettes: 0–4 °C, 24 h or −18 °C, 1 month. Aioli: 0–4 °C, 48 h.
8fab7756.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, breadcrumbs) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter) · 12 Molluscs (octopus). Check curry powder label (may contain 9 Celery or 10 Mustard).

c: Blend leaves with oil at 70 °C 2 min; strain through a cloth; chill at once to keep it green.
Blend all; rest 15 min; pass through a fine sieve; keep 0–4 °C.
Use fish frozen at −20 °C for 24 h (parasite control); dice 1 cm; keep on ice.
Shave palm heart into ribbons; red onion in fine julienne, iced water 10 min.
To order: dress fish with tiger's milk 2 min only; season.
Serve in a chilled bowl: fish, palm ribbons, onion, coriander; 4 g oil in drops.
9a86686f.st: Diced fish: 0–2 °C, same day. Tiger's milk: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Oil: 0–4 °C, 5 days.

589026b9.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 2 pieces ≈ 60 g (vegan snack)
c: Boil cassava 20 min until tender; remove the fibrous core.
Blend with water, salt and turmeric to a smooth paste; spread 1 mm on a silicone mat.
Dry at 80 °C 3 h; break into 6 cm pieces.
Fry at 190 °C 5–10 s until puffed; drain.
Dice heart of palm and green mango 4 mm; red onion brunoise.
Bind with coconut cream, lime juice and zest, chilli, coriander and salt just before service.
To order: 21 g tartare on each crisp; micro herbs; 2 pieces per guest.
589026b9.st: Crisps: airtight, 48 h. Tartare: dice ahead 0–4 °C, 12 h; dress to order.

7e1bd029.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 4 pieces + chutney ≈ 80 g (snack)
c: Soak split peas 6 h; drain well; grind coarse without water.
Mix in finely chopped onion, spring onion, chilli, ginger, garlic, curry leaves, cumin, turmeric, salt.
Shape 15 g balls, press a dimple with the thumb.
Fry at 170 °C 3–4 min until deep golden and crisp; drain.
Blend all to a smooth bright green paste; keep 0–4 °C.
Serve 4 hot gato piman on a banana leaf with 20 g chutney in a small dish.
7e1bd029.st: Raw mix: 0–4 °C, 24 h; fry to order. Chutney: 0–4 °C, 24 h.

c: Mix egg whites, melted butter, flour, coconut and salt; rest 30 min.
Spread thin 6 cm ovals on a silicone mat; bake 160 °C 6–8 min until golden.
Shape over a rolling pin while warm; keep airtight.
Boil water, sugar and agar 1 min; add lime juice; set at 0–4 °C; blend to a fluid gel.
Flake fish finely; beat soft butter with coconut cream.
Fold in fish, shallot brunoise, lime zest, chilli, coriander; season; chill 1 h.
To order: 18 g rillettes quenelle on each tuile, 3 dots of lime gel; 2 per guest.
a83ffa2b.st: Tuiles: airtight, 48 h. Rillettes: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Gel: 0–4 °C, 3 days.
a83ffa2b.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg whites) · 4 Fish (smoked tuna or kingfish) · 7 Milk (butter)

c: Blend coconut cream, lime juice, zest and salt; stream in oil to a glossy emulsion; pipe bottle.
Slice shallots 1 mm; start in cold oil, heat to 150 °C, fry until light golden; drain, salt.
Fine julienne of papaya; salt 15 min, squeeze dry; dress with lime, ginger, chilli, sugar.
Tuna previously frozen at −20 °C 24 h; dice 5 mm on a chilled board, keep over ice.
To order: season 60 g tuna with shallot, chilli, spring onion, coriander, lime, oil, salt.
Ring-mould on a chilled plate; 20 g satini on top; dots of emulsion; crispy shallots last.
6ec4c3c9.st: Diced tuna: 0–2 °C, max 4 h. Emulsion: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Shallots: airtight, 48 h.

69529fea.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 230 g (180 g consommé poured at the table)
c: Fumet: rinse bones, cover with cold water, bring up slowly, simmer 25 min (never boil); strain, cool to 4 °C.
Raft: mix minced fish, egg whites, chopped tomato, onion, ginger, lemongrass, garlic, thyme; whisk into the cold stock.
Heat slowly, stirring until 60 °C; stop stirring; raft sets at 80 °C; bare simmer 30 min, core ≥ 63 °C.
Ladle through a hole in the raft, strain through a cloth; season; must be crystal clear.
Purge clams in salted water 1 h; steam open in a little consommé 2 min; pick half, keep half in shell.
Chayote brunoise 3 mm, blanch 1 min; young moringa leaves raw.
Warm bowl: clams, chayote, moringa, spring onion, chilli slice.
Pour 180 g consommé at 85 °C at the table from a small pot.
69529fea.st: Consommé: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Clams: live 2–4 °C, 24 h; cook to order.
69529fea.al: 3 Eggs (egg whites) · 4 Fish (fish bones, grouper trim) · 12 Molluscs (small clams). Egg whites are only in the clarification raft and are strained out; declare 3 Eggs.

77046872.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 330 g (soup, 230 g poured at the table)
c: Rinse bones in cold water 20 min.
Cover with cold water; bring to a simmer; skim; add aromatics; simmer 25 min; strain through a cloth.
Sweat onion, garlic, ginger, lemongrass in oil 6 min; add turmeric and tomato paste 2 min.
Add tomatoes, chilli, thyme and stock; simmer 25 min.
Blend; pass through a fine sieve; season.
Boil and press potato; blend warm with egg, garlic, chilli, turmeric, lime and salt.
Stream in olive oil to a thick emulsion.
Slice bread 5 mm; rub with garlic; brush with oil; bake 170 °C 8–10 min until crisp.
Cut snapper in 30 g pieces; poach in simmering soup 3–4 min (core 63 °C).
Warm bowl: 63 g fish and moringa leaves; pour 230 g soup at 85 °C at the table.
Croutons spread with 15 g rouille on the side.
77046872.st: Soup base: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Rouille: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Croutons: airtight, 48 h.
77046872.al: 1 Gluten (white bread) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 4 Fish (fish bones, red snapper fillet)

c: Steam breadfruit 25 min until soft; dry in the oven at 160 °C 5 min; pass through a ricer while hot.
Mix in egg, salt, nutmeg and flour with minimal work to a soft dough.
Roll 2 cm ropes, cut 2 cm pieces; mark with a fork.
Blanch in salted boiling water until they float + 1 min; ice, drain, oil lightly.
Cook butter to noisette (150 °C) with curry leaves until the leaves are crisp; lift the leaves out for garnish.
Off the heat add flaked smoked fish, lime zest and chilli.
Pan-fry gnocchi in oil until golden on two sides.
Toss with 28 g warm smoked fish butter per portion; spring onion and crisp curry leaves on top.
83a21405.st: Blanched gnocchi: 0–4 °C, 48 h or −18 °C, 1 month. Butter: make per service.
83a21405.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 4 Fish (smoked job fish) · 7 Milk (butter)

a912d073.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 180 g (5 prawns, starter)
c: Cook butter to noisette (nutty, 150 °C); stop with lime juice.
Add bilimbi brunoise and salt off the heat; hold warm.
Slice 1.5 mm; rinse, dry; fry 160 °C until golden; salt.
Cut through the back shell, devein, butterfly; marinate with garlic, chilli, oil 15 min.
Grill over hot charcoal 2 min per side, just opaque (core 60 °C).
Plate 5 prawns, spoon over 24 g hot beurre noisette, crisps, charred lime.
a912d073.st: Prawns: 0–2 °C, 24 h. Butter: make per service. Crisps: airtight, 24 h.

c: Vacuum with oil, salt and bay; cook 77 °C for 5 h; ice bath 30 min; keep the bag juices.
To order: char on hot charcoal 1 min per side, 100 g per portion.
Sweat onion, garlic, ginger, curry leaves; fry curry powder 1 min; add tomato 3 min.
Add coconut milk and octopus bag juices (or water); simmer 10 min.
Blend, pass through a fine sieve; reduce to nappe; finish with lime.
Simmer breadfruit pieces in coconut milk and a little water 20 min until soft.
Blend hot with butter until silky; pass; season; hold 65 °C.
Curry leaf crisps: fry leaves at 170 °C 5–10 s; drain, salt.
Swipe 50 g purée; charred octopus on top; 45 g velouté around; curry leaf crisps.
ae6852aa.st: Cooked octopus in bag: 0–4 °C, 5 days. Velouté: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Purée: 0–4 °C, 48 h.
ae6852aa.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 12 Molluscs (octopus tentacles). Check curry powder label (may contain 9 Celery or 10 Mustard).

d6a84ba6.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 140 g (2 cakes, starter)
c: Check crab for shell; boil and mash potatoes; cool.
Mix crab, potato, mayonnaise, egg, 40 g breadcrumbs, spring onion, coriander, zest, chilli, salt.
Shape 20 × 45 g cakes; coat in remaining breadcrumbs; chill 1 h.
Pan-fry in oil 2–3 min per side until golden (core 75 °C).
Grate peeled green papaya; salt 10 min; squeeze dry.
Mix with red onion brunoise, grated ginger, chilli, lime and oil.
Simmer bilimbi with water and sugar 5 min; blend; pass.
Boil with agar 1 min; set at 0–4 °C; blend to a fluid gel.
40 g satini in a ring; 2 hot crab cakes beside; 5 dots of gel; micro herbs.
d6a84ba6.st: Raw crab cakes: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Satini: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Gel: 0–4 °C, 3 days.

f04dde41.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 230 g (170 g bisque poured at the table)
c: Sweat onion, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, curry leaves; fry curry powder and tomato paste 2 min.
Add shells, tomatoes and water; simmer 40 min (core ≥ 63 °C); crush the shells; strain through a chinois.
Add coconut milk, reduce to 1800 g; blend; pass; finish with lime and salt.
Check crab meat for shell; bind gently with coconut cream, lime, spring onion, chilli, coriander.
Blend at 70 °C 2 min; strain through a cloth; chill.
48 g crab salad quenelle in a warm bowl.
Pour 170 g bisque at 85 °C at the table; 4 g oil in drops.
f04dde41.al: 2 Crustaceans (crab shells & bodies, crab meat). Check curry powder label (may contain 9 Celery or 10 Mustard).

c: Bruise and chop lemongrass; warm with oil to 60 °C 20 min; infuse 12 h; strain.
Whisk lime, salt, sugar and chilli; whisk in oil.
Slice palm heart 1 mm on a mandoline to order (it browns); overlap in a 20 cm circle on a cold plate.
Brush with vinaigrette; 30 g flaked smoked fish; green mango brunoise.
Finish with drops of citronelle oil, micro herbs and salt flakes.
f9b1b843.st: Palm heart whole: 0–4 °C, 3 days; slice to order. Oil: 0–4 °C, 5 days.

c: Cut fresh palm in 10 × 150 g sections; brush with oil; salt.
Roast directly on charcoal embers 12–15 min, turning, until charred outside and tender inside (core 75 °C).
Reduce wine, shallots and lime juice to one fifth.
Add cream, boil 1 min; whisk in cold diced butter off the heat (max 65 °C); strain.
Fold in flaked smoked fish; hold at 60 °C, max 2 h.
Place 125 g warm palm, charred side up.
Spoon 42 g beurre blanc around; spring onion and micro herbs.
cb618aec.st: Palm: roast to order; raw 0–4 °C, 3 days wrapped. Beurre blanc: per service.
cb618aec.al: 4 Fish (smoked job fish) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

c: Season yoghurt; hang in a cloth over a bowl 12 h at 0–4 °C; finish with lime zest.
Char whole aubergines over flame or charcoal 15–20 min until collapsed; steam in a covered bowl 10 min; peel; chop.
Fry cumin in oil 30 s; sweat onion, garlic, ginger, chilli; add tomato 3 min.
Mix with aubergine, lime, coriander; season; serve at room temperature.
Toast coconut and curry leaves in oil over low heat until golden; crush; salt.
Swipe 40 g labneh; 90 g satini in a ring; crumb and micro herbs on top.
4a1c4d4c.st: Labneh: 0–4 °C, 5 days. Satini: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Crumb: airtight, 1 week.

c: Blanch spring onion 10 s, ice, squeeze dry; blend with oil 2 min; strain through a cloth; chill.
Soak salted fish 24 h at 0–4 °C, changing the water 3 times.
Poach fish in coconut milk with garlic, thyme and bay 8 min, core ≥ 63 °C; flake, remove bones.
Beat fish with warm breadfruit, adding the coconut milk and oil in a stream; lime and pepper; taste before any salt.
Quail eggs: 2 min 20 s in boiling water, ice bath, peel.
Breadfruit shards: slice 1 mm, fry 160 °C until crisp, salt.
Warm quenelle of 95 g brandade; halved quail egg on top; breadfruit shards; green oil around.
32acf97a.st: Brandade: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat to 75 °C. Quail eggs: cook per service. Oil: 0–4 °C, 5 days.

c: Chill lobsters 20 min in ice water; split the head to dispatch.
Poach in salted water 8 min per 500 g, core ≥ 63 °C; plunge into ice water.
Remove tail meat; slice 1 cm medallions; keep 0–4 °C.
Chop inner lemongrass and ginger very fine; dissolve sugar and salt in lime juice.
Add oil, lemongrass, ginger, chilli; rest 30 min; strain.
Peel and seed papaya; fine julienne with carrot on a mandoline; soak in ice water 10 min; spin dry.
Add sliced red onion, spring onion and coriander leaves.
Toast dry in a pan over low heat until golden; cool.
To order: dress 65 g papaya salad with 10 g dressing; pile high on a cold plate.
Lay 65 g lobster medallions, brush with 5 g dressing; toasted coconut and micro herbs.
135c2167.st: Lobster meat: 0–2 °C, 24 h. Salad: 0–4 °C, 12 h undressed. Dressing: 0–4 °C, 3 days.

c: Crush cinnamon; warm with oil to 70 °C 20 min; infuse 12 h; strain.
Sweat onion, garlic, ginger, thyme in oil 5 min.
Add pumpkin and water; simmer 20 min until soft.
Add coconut milk; blend until silky; pass; season with salt and nutmeg.
Warm bowl: 15 g flaked smoked fish, seeds, spring onion; pour 210 g velouté at 85 °C at the table; oil drops.
Dry-brine belly with salt 12 h at 0–4 °C; rinse.
Braise skin up with water and aromatics, covered, at 90 °C 12 h until very tender.
Strain and keep 600 g liquor; press belly under a weight 12 h at 0–4 °C.
Fry garlic, ginger, curry leaves and curry powder in oil 1 min.
Add liquor, tamarind and honey; reduce by two thirds.
Add coconut milk; reduce to a coating glaze; strain.
Peel and julienne green mango; mix with red onion, grated ginger, chilli, lime, coriander, salt; rest 15 min.
Sear blocks skin down in a dry pan 6–8 min until the crackling is crisp; heat through at 180 °C 6 min (core 75 °C).
Brush the meat sides with 25 g hot glaze; plate skin up with 35 g satini.
cbb85548.st: Pressed belly: 0–4 °C, 4 days. Glaze: 0–4 °C, 1 week. Satini: 0–4 °C, 12 h.
cbb85548.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Check curry powder label (may contain 9 Celery or 10 Mustard).

c: Toast whole spices dry 1 min; grind coarse; mix with curry powder, salt and sugar.
Roast whole at 200 °C 50 min; scoop out.
Blend hot with butter and coconut milk; pass; season with lime and salt.
Reduce stock with shallots, garlic, thyme to 300 g; strain.
Cook lentils separately 15 min until just tender; drain.
Fold lentils into the jus; mount with butter; add fried curry leaves.
Temper 180 g fillet portions 30 min; press masala on the top side.
Sear 1–2 min per side, baste with butter and thyme; oven 180 °C to core 52–54 °C; rest 6 min.
Plate 90 g purée, fillet, 35 g lantiy jus.
1aafa077.st: Fillet portions: 0–2 °C, 72 h vacuum. Purée: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Jus: 0–4 °C, 72 h.
